posts.title: VLC as a snap does not play DVD? Here's your solution.
posts.description: For a world that ain't just focused on pure all-digital subscription nonsense. I've written a tutorial on how to regain DVD playback in VLC 3.0.24 packaged as a snap for Linux, including relevant DVD libraries missing from the snap, how to download and unpack the snap squashfs archive, how to add necessary files into the snap, how to repack and test the application, snapd parallel installs option,

posts.title: An all-digital future means constant security breaches
posts.description: Here's a mostly sad article about the poor state of global digital infrastructure, with constant incidents and breaches of exposed services, pointless modern trend of interconnectedness and associated societal and economic risks, important lessons from the past, Cheapness as a Service, cost of IT security, correct balance between analog and digital, future outlook, and more. Have fun, sort of.

posts.title: BMW X1 xDrive25e review - Underpowered, thirsty greenster
posts.description: I written a largely grumpy review of the previous-generation BMW X1 xDrive25e with a 1.5-liter hybrid plug-in petrol engine, covering 1,000 km over a two-day urban and highway journey, including M-kit look and feel, interior and ergonomics, subpar driving experience with excessively high fuel consumption, some other observations, and more. Take a look.
